description: Use when you need what a wallet or contract holds: reads the native ETH balance and ERC-20 balances (a default set of major tokens, or up to 20 token symbols/addresses you pass) for one address on Base or Ethereum in a single multicall, with human-readable amounts and USD values from Chainlink feeds, plus a total. Zero balances are omitted unless asked. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.003 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.

tokens.description: Comma-separated token symbols (from the default list) or 0x token addresses, max 20. Default: major tokens of the chain.

name: balances
title: ScrapeMole Onchain: prices, DEX prices, ENS/Basenames, gas, tokens, balances, holders and transactions on Base and Ethereum: Wallet balances
